title: SoftBank-Backed OPay Eyes Up to $500 Million in New York Listing
summary: SoftBank-backed fintech OPay plans to raise about $500 million via a private placement and an IPO in New York, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Google Debuts $180 Fitbit Edge Tracker, Replacing the Fitbit Charge 6
summary: Google launched the $180 Fitbit Edge tracker, replacing the Fitbit Charge 6 and showcasing the revamped Google Health app.

title: Private Equity Has €41 Billion of Headroom for Dividend Recaps
summary: Private equity firms have about €41 billion of headroom to add debt to portfolio companies to fund dividend recaps, as volatility makes exits harder.

title: Mexican Businesses See Bigger Hit From Local Problems Than Trade Risk
summary: Bloomberg reports that Mexican businesses weighing investment see domestic problems as a bigger risk than trade tensions with Washington.

title: How Could AI Be Regulated? A Guide to Kill Switches, Safety Testing and More
summary: A Bloomberg guide to proposals for regulating AI, from mandatory safety-incident reporting to an outright ban on 'superintelligent' systems.

title: Mall of Berlin Lenders Eye Debt Sale as Owners Try to Refinance
summary: Creditors of Berlin's struggling Mall of Berlin want to sell about €550 million of debt while owners try to refinance.

title: IonQ to Buy Elisity for Up to $1.3 Billion to Bolster Cyber Unit
summary: IonQ agreed to buy cybersecurity firm Elisity for up to $1.3 billion in stock to protect against AI-assisted and quantum threats.

title: UK to Evaluate AI Models Before Release, Reversing Trump Policy
summary: The UK will be able to evaluate leading AI models, including those from OpenAI and Anthropic, before release, reversing a US policy that required White House approval first.

title: HSBC Moves to Wall Street Bonus Model
summary: HSBC will phase out fixed-pay allowances for senior staff and shift more compensation into bonuses, joining UK lenders moving to Wall Street-style pay.

title: AI Data Centers Face Power Crunch
summary: Developers of huge AI data centers face a major problem getting enough electricity to power them.

title: AI in Banking: Junior Bankers Find Work Managing AI Agents
summary: Goldman's Asia-Pacific president says junior bankers now start their careers managing AI agents. The piece looks at how banks are reshaping entry-level work around agentic AI.

title: El terremoto dio un golpe adicional al débil mercado de vivienda en Colombia: ventas se desploman
summary: El terremoto del 10 de agosto profundizó la debilidad del mercado de vivienda en Colombia; en Risaralda las ventas cayeron 80,2% anual, según Camacol.

title: Broadcom CEO Likens Many AI Investors to Casino Gamblers
summary: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan likened many AI investors to casino gamblers who have little understanding of what they are betting on.

title: Erosión del carry trade le pega al peso mexicano: Diferencial de tasas entre México y EU dispara al dólar
summary: El peso mexicano extendió sus pérdidas a niveles de hace 10 meses y acumula cinco semanas a la baja. La erosión del carry trade por un menor diferencial de tasas entre México y EU presiona al tipo de cambio.

title: Tencent Tells Investors Its $5 Billion Bond Mainly for AI Capex
summary: Tencent told fixed-income investors its planned ~$5 billion bond will mainly finance AI-related capital expenditures.

title: Firmus IPO Debacle Raises the Bar for Asia AI Deals in Pipeline
summary: The collapse of Firmus Grid's IPO is making investors pickier about Asian AI infrastructure deals that hinge on future earnings.

title: Shadow AI, cuando la Inteligencia Artificial aumenta el trabajo en tu negocio en lugar de reducirlo
summary: El artículo analiza el fenómeno de 'Shadow AI': el uso no controlado de IA en los negocios que puede aumentar la carga de trabajo y poner en riesgo la información de los clientes.

title: IMF Chief Alarmed at ‘Slow-Moving Tsunami’ of AI for Jobs, Taxes
summary: The IMF chief warned of a 'slow-moving tsunami' from AI for jobs and taxation, urging policymakers to rethink education and act now.

title: TikTok’s Chew and Microsoft’s Althoff Warn About Runaway AI Hype
summary: Tech leaders from TikTok and Microsoft warned that the world may be overexcited about AI and overlooking its immaturity, arguing cybersecurity is a bigger near-term issue than AI advancing too quickly.

title: El presidente de Microsoft, Brad Smith, dice que la leche está más regulada que la IA
summary: El presidente de Microsoft, Brad Smith, afirmó que la IA necesita regulación global urgente con evaluadores independientes y que hoy enfrenta menos requisitos de seguridad que la leche.

title: El FMI insta a los países miembros a actuar con rapidez en materia de deuda e inflación
summary: Kristalina Georgieva instó a los países miembros del FMI a actuar con rapidez ante repuntes de inflación y a reducir los elevados déficits.

title: El FMI dice que la inversión en IA mantiene el crecimiento mundial en torno al 3%
summary: La directora del FMI dijo que la fuerte inversión en infraestructura de IA mantiene el crecimiento mundial en torno al 3%, con beneficios para economías asiáticas proveedoras de hardware.

title: Wall Street’s record-breaking trading streak set to cool
summary: Analysts forecast a sharp slowdown in Wall Street banks' third-quarter results next week after a bumper start to the year.

title: ‘Worrying omens’ stalk global economy despite resilient growth
summary: FT research shows major economies withstanding the Iran shock, but rising public debt concerns will loom over the IMF and World Bank meetings.

title: The huge lurking leverage of AI hyperscalers
summary: Creditors are scrutinising liabilities such as data-centre leases at AI hyperscalers even as equity investors look to sunny futures.

title: DBS CEO Tan Says Market Is Repricing Risks on AI Financing
summary: DBS CEO Tan Su Shan says the market is repricing risks around AI-related investment, which could bring more discipline to financing.
